identity.name: Fisher Island
identity.notes: Fisher Island is a 216-acre private barrier island in Miami-Dade County, Florida (ZIP 33109), at the mouth of Government Cut directly across from South Pointe Park. It contains roughly 700–800 residences — primarily Mediterranean-style mid-rise condos, plus townhomes and a limited set of single-family waterfront estates — with no road or bridge connection to the mainland; access is only by controlled/private ferry, yacht, or authorized helicopter, with pre-arranged security clearance required for ferry guests. 2020 census population: 561. In October 2025 it was reported as the most expensive ZIP code in the U.S., with a median home price of ~$9.5 million (+65% YoY). Named for developer Carl G. Fisher; originally the private winter estate of William K. Vanderbilt II. Created by the dredging of Government Cut.

Controlled/private ferry is the standard means of access; private yacht and authorized helicopter also permitted. No public bridge connects the island to Miami Beach.
